g.text: 03 HR-V0 actuator branch protection, star power injection, and one TTL data bus

g.desc: 03 HR-V0 actuator branch protection, star power injection, and one TTL data bus

g.text: NOTE 3: Standard fully populated 3-pin TTL cables carry VDD and would parallel the protected branches. Release a data-only harness/breakout and pass continuity plus no-backfeed tests.

g.desc: NOTE 3: Standard fully populated 3-pin TTL cables carry VDD and would parallel the protected branches. Release a data-only harness/breakout and pass continuity plus no-backfeed tests.

g.text: Each actuator receives an individually protected power branch. The U2D2 participates in signaling only; actuator current is not summed through a U2D2 Power Hub.

g.desc: Each actuator receives an individually protected power branch. The U2D2 participates in signaling only; actuator current is not summed through a U2D2 Power Hub.

g.text: NOTE 2: The former 20 A / 7.5 A / 7.5 A / 3 A values are not carried into V2 as approved selections.

g.desc: NOTE 2: The former 20 A / 7.5 A / 7.5 A / 3 A values are not carried into V2 as approved selections.

g.text: NOTE 1: Provisional IDs are configuration data, not connector pin numbers. Release requires a collision scan and recorded configuration hash.
